string.text: Shortened barrel

Makes the weapon more compact and reduces its weight - unfortunately, at the cost of reducing accuracy and increasing the spread of bullets, as well as depriving the weapon of the ability to install a silencer.
Barrel bluing
A special heat-resistant coating makes the weapon barrel more resistant to adverse environmental conditions, increasing the reliability of the weapon.
Refinement of the bore
Allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet, due to which it deviates less from the expected trajectory and reaches the target faster.Useful for long range shooting.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Wear-resistant USM
Replacing standard trigger parts with high-strength analogues allows you to extend the service life of the weapon and ensure its trouble-free operation in the harsh conditions of the Zone.
Tactical grip
Installing an under-barrel grip allows you to make the weapon more convenient to handle, making shooting and compensating for recoil much easier.
USM calibration
Individual fitting of the trigger mechanism parts allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Tactical module
Installation of a special tactical unit on a weapon, which combines the functions of a laser target designator and a tactical flashlight.An indispensable thing for fighting at night.
Store expansion
Installing an extender that makes the magazine longer allows you to load more rounds into the weapon, making reloads less frequent.
Rail fastening
Allows you to install various types of sights on weapons.
Recoil compensator
The introduction of a special polymer damper into the design of the weapon makes it possible to slightly reduce the recoil felt by the shooter.
USM balancing
Balancing the standard parts of the trigger mechanism reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing.
Improved cutoff
Modification of the cartridge ejection system reduces the likelihood of delays during shooting due to the cartridge case sticking after the shot.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Lightweight stock
Cavities in the butt allow the weapon to be lighter.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Light alloy parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of light alloys allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon without significant harm to its other tactical and technical characteristics.
Chamber adjustment
Allows you to improve obturation and achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
